cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Only six people cracked our supper-club invitation. Excellent: a more selective table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five thought it was a puzzle night. They've cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Wonderful. We've filtered out everyone who wasn't committed to dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last one's the printer asking to be paid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An invitation-only dinner with our sole supplier. It's become a private partnership event.

mechanism: A corrects how a helper handles dwindling attendance so every lost guest becomes refinement toward an exclusive supplier dinner.
confusable: Merely tolerating cancellations misses the celebration; A must find a new claimed improvement and make B act accordingly.
comparison: Hospitality and a business contact differ from a hidden proposal's public camouflage.
seedUse: Use puzzle invitation, cancellations and printer payment; let B propose doorstep payment for A to correct into hospitality.
